text: Android: capture crashes to a local log with a 'share logs' option in Settings

Done. A real Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler (CrashHandler) installed in ShoppingListApp.onCreate(), logging to a bounded local ring-buffer file (CrashLogWriter, app-private storage) before delegating to the previous handler. Settings > 'Share crash logs' fires a share-sheet Intent via a new FileProvider, or shows 'No crash logs yet'. No telemetry service, purely local/opt-in. Both classes are plain JVM (Context only via a thin Hilt @Provides) so they get genuine unit test coverage. Commit 03eaafa.
